verdict.rationale: Unit's own docs say deposit and wallet accounts are held in FBO structures and run on a native ledger. They also say the Dashboard and APIs give teams access to account and transaction data. That partly explains the account structure and who sees the data, but only as thin marketing-level statements. missing for 10: any documentation of where FDIC insurance attaches (pass-through coverage per end customer), a plain comparison of FBO pools versus individually titled accounts, explicit ledger visibility and permission rules (partner bank versus platform versus end customer), and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, the account structure is transparent — whether funds sit in FBO pools or individual accounts, where FDIC insurance actually attaches, and who can see the ledger, all documented plainly

citations.quote: Create deposit accounts and wallet accounts held in FBO structures.
They run on a unified infrastructure and native ledger
The Unit Dashboard and APIs provide teams with access to customer, account, payment, card, transaction, compliance, and operational data.
